summary: A revision keeps the reason a step is blocked, and a blocked step that names no blocker is recomputed so it becomes ready (and its seat is woken) instead of staying blocked behind a finished predecessor

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes. Existing claims replay as before.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or data rewrites. The claim vocabulary gains one optional field, covered under compatibility.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: The step-run.carried claim gains an optional string field `reason`, written only when a revision carries a blocked step that has a reason. A member still on the previous build may refuse to import such a claim until it is upgraded, so upgrade all members before revising a mission that has a blocked step. Clients are unaffected.

manual.detail: No operator steps. A step already stuck in blocked with no reason recovers on the first reconcile pass after the upgrade.

recovery.detail: Rolling back the reconciler change is safe. After a revision has written a carried claim with `reason`, a member on the previous build may refuse that claim, so roll forward rather than back once such a revision exists.
